title: The crisis of 1982: Volcker and Mexico
goal: Read how higher US interest rates and Mexico's announcement of August 1982 began the debt crisis, using the pluperfect.
grammar: the pluperfect with había + past participle

items: I can explain what the US Federal Reserve did in October 1979 and why.
I can explain why higher interest rates and lower export prices hurt Latin American countries.
I can say what Mexico announced in August 1982 and how the crisis spread.
I can use *había* + a participle for what had already happened when the crisis broke out.
